title: Diffusion Model
description: Generative model creating data by learning to reverse a progressive noise corruption process.
name: Diffusion Model
summary: Diffusion Models generate data by first corrupting inputs with Gaussian noise over multiple forward steps, and then training a neural network (typically a U-Net) to predict and remove noise step-by-step to recover the clean signal.
use_when: Generating state-of-the-art synthetic images, audio waveforms, or 3D assets.
avoid_when: Ultra-low-latency real-time rendering is required, as the iterative reverse process is slow.
pros: Outperforms GANs on image generation diversity and quality.
Extremely stable training objective with no adversarial collapse risk.
Can be conditioned on text embeddings for text-to-image synthesis.
cons: Very slow generation speed due to evaluation over hundreds of denoising steps.

key_hyperparams.name: num_timesteps
key_hyperparams.note: Number of noise corruption and reverse denoising steps to evaluate.
